findings.rule: `render_hooks` resolves each to the installed script and writes `$REINSET_HOOKS` (default `~/.claude/reinset/hooks.json`).
findings.input: Implementer order; `~/.claude/skills/handing-off/` exists without the `.pandoscope-compose` marker and holds a hand-written `guard.sh` (or: a marked `handing-off` copy from an earlier session exists and this session's clones have no `handing-off` source).
findings.finding: install_bundle refuses (or cannot source) handing-off and leaves it out of `installed`, yet render_hooks only checks the profile's skill list and `path.is_file()`, so hooks.json points PreCompact and SessionStart/compact at a script the bundle did not install.

findings.rule: An entry outside the bundle, missing on disk or on an unknown event is a composer error.
findings.input: Profile hook `{event: PreCompact, command: handing-off/../../../../usr/local/bin/x.sh}` with handing-off in the role's skills and the target file present.
findings.finding: The bundle check only compares the text before the first `/` with the skill list, so a command whose script part climbs out of `~/.claude/skills/handing-off` renders as a hook on a file outside the bundle instead of a composer error.

findings.rule: The prompt pass and its add-only rule are gone.
findings.input: `install_bundle(profile, session_root, home, repos, prune=False)` after an earlier pass installed `grilling` for a role that no longer names it (tests/unit/reinset/test_install.py:142).
findings.finding: The change keeps the add-only mode as a `prune=False` path, documents it as live behaviour ("a pass inside a running session only adds (D2)", install.py:10) and pins it with a test, although the body states the prompt pass and its add-only rule are removed.
